opening.comment: The agent's first turn does not give their own name or the company name, so the opening criterion is not met.

verification.quote:
Customer: ...My name is Niamh Willems, postcode 2513 AA.
Agent: Yes. Thank you, Niamh, that matches your account.
verification.comment: The caller gave full name and postcode and the agent confirmed both against the account before proceeding.

understanding.quote: Agent: ...So the toaster arrived yesterday and doesn't turn on at all?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent refunded €22.00 as a full refund and said no return is needed, but under policy items under €25 need no return, so this is correct; the 5-working-day refund timeline is also correct. However the agent did not check the damaged-item eligibility or ask for the photo, and the refund was offered without the required steps, so accuracy is judged correct on amounts and timelines.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
process_compliance.comment: For a faulty or damaged item the agent must ask for a photo before arranging a refund, and the agent skipped this step entirely.

communication.comment: The agent was sympathetic at first but ended abruptly with a curt phrase and did not thank the caller or close politely.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps in full or ask if there was anything else, and ended the call without a polite close.
